description: The Hyderabad Police launched ‘AI-CopWriter’, an AI-powered mobile application that records, transcribes and translates complaints in 10 Indian languages in real time. The app helps generate FIR drafts quickly and aims to improve efficiency and uniformity across police stations
body_lead: Home |Hyderabad |Hyderabad Police Launch Ai Copwriter To Accept Complaints Hyderabad police launch AI-CopWriter to accept complaints The Hyderabad Police launched ‘AI-CopWriter’, an AI-powered mobile application that records, transcribes and translates complaints in 10 Indian languages in real time.
